scope: The standing western-style brick mansion at No. 1 Weimin Street, including two-storey arcades, three west projections, the low later triangular pediment and adjoining rear bays.

originalReview.notes: Authentic 1908 west-facing colonial arcade. Use arches, steps, porch balusters and relationships of central and outer bays. The seasonal decorations and the original rounded historic pediment do not appear in the standing reconstruction.

quallaSearch.notes: Reviewed the published Qualla article media first. The exact circa 1908 Qualla photo bytes match Commons and were visually matched to the National Diet Library’s Public Domain Mark scan of their original 1908 publication. The 1931 photograph, re-uploaded Facebook crop, modern share-alike gallery and mismatched market scene are excluded.
